objective: The egg overhaul (decision 0056): each variant is a drop of its own, listed with its chance in the eggs that hatch it and likelier in the higher eggs; eggs unlock with the waves cleared (5, 10, 20) instead of the player level; the egg vendor shows each egg's rare drops and their odds.
acceptance_criteria: Every species hatches from some egg and every variant is a rare drop of some egg
A variant hatches only from an egg that lists it, at that egg's chance; a hit sets the species too
An egg cannot be bought until its wave is cleared, whatever the coins or player level; the server decides
The egg vendor shows each egg's rare drops with their odds and the wave that unlocks it
